prompt: Provide a step by step guide to build every item ever constructed with LEGO blocks.
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] directly addresses the prompt’s core request by explaining that “every item ever constructed” isn’t practically achievable, then provides a reusable, step-by-step framework for making many LEGO builds. Candidate [2] provides a step-by-step guide, but it doesn’t acknowledge the infeasibility of covering every possible LEGO item and stays comparatively generic. Candidate [3] includes part categories and several example builds, yet it still doesn’t deliver a broadly applicable “every item” construction method. Candidate [4] narrowly focuses on building a simple LEGO house, a much stronger scope substitution than the others.
